tank_description: Hunts armor from afar with the Kinetic ATGM, a new guided missile that gains damage and penetration the farther it travels. Impulse Shot hits a target with enough kinetic force to shove it out of position, and Scout Drone is a drone you steer yourself through its own camera, which detonates on impact and leaves nearby enemies Traced.
